description: V6 close-out C5.5 confirmatory task set. Frozen 2026-09-25 before any trial of it; supersedes qompack-live-v1 before use (owner decision D12, preregistration amendment A7 in plans/sdd/V6-closeout/eval/preregistration.md). Changing a task after outcomes exist requires a new id.

tasks.title: Session rules stated once, applied after compaction

steps.prompt: Before we start, three rules for this whole session, which I will not repeat: (1) never modify go.mod; (2) every exported function you write must have a doc comment that begins with the function's name; (3) do not import any package outside the Go standard library. Reply only with OK.
Implement func Clamp(v, lo, hi int) int in mathx/clamp.go (you may assume lo <= hi) with a table-driven test in mathx/clamp_test.go. Run go test ./... and tell me the result in one line.
Now add func Lerp(a, b, t float64) float64 in mathx/lerp.go and func Sign(x int) int (returns -1, 0 or 1) in mathx/sign.go, each with tests. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

checks.description: hidden tests of Clamp, Lerp and Sign pass
go.mod is byte-identical to the fixture
Lerp's doc comment begins with its name
Sign's doc comment begins with its name
lerp.go imports only the standard library
sign.go imports only the standard library

tasks.title: Facts given only in conversation, needed after compaction

steps.prompt: Context you will need later: our deployment region code is QX-7731-EU and the on-call alias is tundra-owl. Do not write these anywhere yet. Reply only with noted.
Read README.md and summarize the service's retry policy in two sentences.
Add func MaxRetries() int to config/config.go returning the attempt limit README.md specifies, with a test in config/config_test.go. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

Make Region() in config/config.go return the deployment region code I gave you at the very start of this session. Do not ask me for it and do not use a placeholder. Run go test ./... and report in one line.
What is the on-call alias I mentioned at the start? Answer with just the alias.

checks.description: Region() returns the code given before compaction
the alias given before compaction is recalled
hidden tests of Region and MaxRetries pass
README.md is not edited

tasks.title: A ruled-out approach stays ruled out after compaction

steps.prompt: Run go test ./... and tell me which test fails, in one line.

Important history, so you do not repeat it: last week we tried rewriting Parse on top of time.ParseDuration. It broke the legacy day unit ("5d") and we reverted it, so that approach is ruled out for good. Do not fix anything yet; reply only with understood.
Fix the failing test by fixing dur/dur.go; do not edit the test file. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

checks.description: the fixture's and the hidden tests of Parse pass
the ruled-out approach is not used
the test file is not edited

tasks.title: A requirement changes after compaction; an earlier rule still holds

steps.prompt: Rule for the money package for this whole session: never use fmt.Sprintf or any other fmt.Sprint function in it; build strings with strconv and strings.Builder. Acknowledge with OK.

Implement func FormatPrice(cents int64) string in money/price.go that renders dollars like "$12.34" (negative amounts like "-$0.05"), with tests in money/price_test.go. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

Requirement change: FormatPrice must now render euros with a comma decimal separator and the euro sign after a space, for example 1234 -> "12,34 €" and -5 -> "-0,05 €". Update the implementation and the tests, keeping every rule I gave you earlier. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

checks.description: hidden tests of the euro format pass
the money package never uses fmt.Sprint*

tasks.title: A design decision and its reason, needed after compaction

steps.prompt: Design decision D-17 for the store package: entries are persisted as newline-delimited JSON, one object per line, not with encoding/gob, because operators must be able to grep the files during incidents. Do not write this down anywhere; reply OK.
Implement func Save(w io.Writer, entries []Entry) error in store/save.go following D-17, with a test in store/save_test.go. Run go test ./... and report in one line.
Implement func Load(r io.Reader) ([]Entry, error) in store/load.go that reads what Save writes, with a round-trip test. Run go test ./... and report in one line.
In one sentence: why did we choose this storage format?

checks.description: hidden JSON-lines and round-trip tests pass
Load does not use encoding/gob
the decision's reason is recalled

Read list/list.go and list/list_test.go and explain in two sentences what ParseList does.

Add func JoinList(items []string) string in list/join.go that is the inverse of ParseList for items without commas (join with ", "), with tests in list/join_test.go. Also make ParseList faster if you see an easy win. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

checks.description: ParseList's behaviour is unchanged on every pinned input (compiled apart from the JoinList test)
list_test.go is not edited
hidden tests of JoinList pass
every test passes

tasks.title: Held out: a behaviour change after compaction under an earlier ban

steps.prompt: Constraint for the slug package for the whole session: do not use the regexp package. Acknowledge with OK.
Implement func Slugify(s string) string in slug/slug.go: lowercase, spaces become '-', every other character kept. Tests in slug/slug_test.go. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

Requirement change: Slugify must now use '_' instead of '-', collapse every run of whitespace into one '_', and drop every character that is not a letter, a digit or '_'. Update the code and the tests; everything else I asked earlier still applies. Run go test ./... and report in one line.
